decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains closely related to the firm's specialist, standards-intensive engineering base, so continued market presence should strengthen learning and make withdrawal unlikely.

The spring-balanced desk lamp still fits the firm's ergonomic office-lighting knowledge, but it is less central to its system-led strategic direction and therefore remains the most exposed to portfolio pruning.
A general interior lighting luminaire sits firmly in the firm's core indoor-lighting capabilities and sales channels, which supports ongoing incremental improvement rather than exit.
As a flagship pendant luminaire aligned with the firm's push into high-quality intelligent interior lighting, it is highly likely to be retained and further developed.

The marine searchlight builds on the firm's robust specialist-lighting competences, and after dropping the less fitting marine HMI line the remaining marine offer is more likely to be consolidated than withdrawn.
